paper_title: Analysis of atomic-clock data to constrain variations of fundamental constants
coupling_convention: d_gamma^(1), linear scalar coupling to photons (dimensionless); values are 10^y from the log10[d_gamma^(1)] axis
notes: Atomic-clock (Sr/Yb+/Cs) search for oscillating fundamental constants interpreted as ultralight scalar dark matter. Multiple couplings constrained (d_gamma linear/quadratic, d_me-d_g, d_q-d_g, Higgs A, QCD axion f_a). The primary NEW highlighted result is the linear photon coupling d(1)_gamma from Yb+/Sr (Fig.6 top), excluding new region for 1e-20 eV < m < 1e-17 eV — mapped to ScalarPhoton. Data points reconstructed from the fit line (d^(1)=zeta_f*A_alpha, A_alpha~7.6e-19, giving d~3.7e12*m[eV]); values increase linearly with mass. Assumes rho_DM=0.3 GeV/cm^3 (paper notes some use 0.4). Because the paper reports several coupling types, extraction confidence for ScalarPhoton specifically is moderate. Note the paper also constrains d_me (ScalarElectron) via Sr/Cs and f_a (AxionMass) via Cs.
